title: Wire server-owned Tenant GPT OAuth correlation from authorize through protected-resource gateway verification

phases.objective: Carry one server-owned OAuth operation/correlation chain from authorize through gateway verification without creating a synthetic Activation run or enabling Recovery OAuth source authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: Tenant GPT OAuth authorization server and protected-resource gateway
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A signed server-owned correlation survives authorize, code issuance, code consumption, token exchange and protected-resource verification as gateway_verify while callback observation and Recovery OAuth source authority remain unavailable.
steps: Create oauth_authorize correlation server-side after client, resource and redirect validation.
Carry only a short-lived signed correlation ticket through the browser and bind it to client, resource, redirect URI and OAuth state.

Verify the ticket at /auth/oauth/code, advance to identity_verify, persist request_correlation_ref as operation_id, then advance to oauth_code_issue and sign the verified claim into the authorization-code JWT.

At /auth/oauth/token, verify code correlation and client/resource/subject/code-JTI bindings, atomically consume the exact row using request_correlation_ref, require readback parity, then advance to oauth_token_exchange with access JTI.
Sign the bounded verified token-exchange correlation claim into the access token.
At protected-resource bearer verification, reject present-but-invalid correlation and advance only verified claims to gateway_verify in server-owned req.auth context.
Keep callback_received unresolved and do not enable OAuth source branding, acquisition receipt signing, migration apply, deployment, provider mutation or Production mutation.

Register the additive OAuth correlation migration in the repository-owned runtime bootstrap execution catalog with runtime target-role binding and explicit column/index postconditions; this PR performs no migration apply.
assertions: request_correlation_ref maps explicitly to OAuth correlation operation_id and has no foreign key to activation_runs.
No synthetic activation_run or parallel correlation ledger is created.
Caller mutation of the correlation ticket fails closed.
Cross-code, cross-client, cross-resource, subject and access-JTI drift fail closed.
Caller-provided req.auth cannot override verified gateway correlation.
activation_operation_projections and activation_stage_attempts are not written before a legitimate Activation run exists.
Production mutation, credential mutation, provider mutation and database apply are outside this PR.

The OAuth correlation migration is explicitly cataloged for governed dry_run/apply_migration against the runtime database with DB_ credential binding, separate governance migration ledger, and same-contract postconditions.
